story_log.title: Wizards win NBA Draft Lottery, get No. 1 pick — Clippers steal Pacers' No. 5 pick in Zubac trade
story_log.development: Draft lottery held today. Wizards won No. 1 overall, Jazz No. 2, Grizzlies No. 3, Bulls No. 4. Pacers' pick jumped to No. 5 but goes to Clippers due to trade protections. First lottery under new anti-tanking rules.

story_log.title: Wemby ejected for elbowing Naz Reid in the jaw — Spurs lose Game 4 without him
story_log.development: Wembanyama received flagrant-2 and first career ejection for elbowing Naz Reid early in 2nd quarter of Game 4. Timberwolves won without facing Wemby, tied series 2-2.

story_log.title: Knicks sweep Sixers 144-114, advance to Eastern Conference Finals
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Knicks completed sweep with Game 4 blowout in Philly. Set playoff record with 18 threes in a half. Deuce McBride 25 points on 7-9 from three. Knicks fans took over arena again. Embiid postgame: 'I don't even know if I'm gonna be here.'

story_log.title: Anthony Edwards dedicates 36-point Game 4 win to late mother on Mother's Day
story_log.development: Edwards dropped 36 points (16 in 4Q) to even series at 2-2. Postgame: 'Today is Mother's Day, I just wanted to win for my mom.' Edwards lost his mother to cancer when he was 14.

story_log.title: Chargers sign David Njoku to 1-year, $8M deal
story_log.development: Njoku left Browns after nine seasons, signed with Chargers on one-year deal worth up to $8M to catch passes from Justin Herbert.

story_log.title: Missouri RB Ahmad Hardy shot at concert, in stable condition after surgery
story_log.development: Missouri All-SEC RB Ahmad Hardy was shot at a concert in Mississippi early Sunday morning, underwent surgery, now in stable condition.

story_log.title: Giants host Cowboys in Week 1 Sunday Night Football — Harbaugh's debut
story_log.development: NFL announced Cowboys at Giants on Sept. 13 as first SNF game of 2026 season. Will be John Harbaugh's Giants coaching debut.

story_log.title: Bobby Cox, Hall of Fame Braves manager who won 1995 World Series, dies at 84
story_log.development: Bobby Cox, who managed the Braves to 14 consecutive division titles and the 1995 World Series, died today at 84. Fourth all-time in managerial wins.

story_log.title: Sean Strickland upsets Khamzat Chimaev by split decision to win middleweight title at UFC 328
story_log.development: Strickland won via split decision as massive underdog, handing Chimaev his first career loss. Second huge upset title win for Strickland after beating Adesanya in 2023.

story_log.title: Thunder go up 3-0 on Lakers with 23-point blowout despite +15 FT disparity for LA
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: OKC won Game 3 in LA despite Lakers shooting 25 FTs to Thunder's 10. Ajay Mitchell had 24-10 with 0 turnovers, Lakers one loss from elimination.

story_log.title: Steve Kerr agrees to 2-year extension to remain Warriors coach, stays highest-paid in NBA
story_log.development: Kerr signed new two-year deal after three weeks of negotiations, remains highest-paid coach in NBA. Continues legendary Warriors partnership into 13th season.

story_log.title: Hurricanes complete back-to-back sweeps, first team to start playoffs 8-0 this century
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Carolina swept Flyers in OT of Game 4, becoming first team this century to open playoffs with consecutive sweeps. Jackson Blake scored OT winner.

story_log.title: Guardians trade No. 29 pick for Giants catcher Patrick Bailey
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: No new development, but trade completed officially today. Bailey acquisition gives Cleveland elite defensive catcher.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark scores 28 in Fever loss to Paige Bueckers, Wings in WNBA opener
story_log.development: Clark had 28 points but Fever lost to Wings in season opener. Paige Bueckers led Dallas. Opening night also saw Angel Reese debut for Dream with 11-14 double-double.

story_log.title: James Harden hits 3 straight clutch buckets as Cavs defend home court in Game 2
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Harden hit three consecutive late-game shots to seal Cavs win. Nonchalant demeanor while doing it drew reactions. Cavs remain undefeated at home.

story_log.title: Shea Langeliers leads all catchers in hits and homers through 38 games
story_log.development: A's catcher Langeliers has 50 hits and 11 HRs, leading all catchers. Hitting .340/.391/.626 with 1.017 OPS and 176 wRC+.

story_log.title: Brewers walk off Yankees in extras after umpires deny Murphy's challenge
story_log.development: Milwaukee rallied from behind after umps ruled manager Pat Murphy took too long to challenge a play at second. William Contreras tied it, Jackson Chourio won it with infield single.

story_log.title: Twins mount wild comeback win after Brooks Lee saves game with defensive gem
story_log.development: Twins won in extras after Brooks Lee made game-saving defensive play in 10th. Byron Buxton and Brooks Lee/Kody Clemens delivered hits in 11th.

story_log.title: Wemby's 39-15-5 gem in Game 3 puts Spurs up 2-1 on the Wolves
story_log.development: Wemby dropped 39 points, 15 rebounds, and 5 blocks (13-18 FG, 16 in 4Q) to lead Spurs to Game 3 road win. First player in NBA history with 35/15/5b on 70%+ FG in playoffs. Chris Finch had on-court confrontation with Tony Brothers. Julius Randle disappeared with 12-0-3 on 3-12 FG.

story_log.title: Knicks go up 3-0 behind Brunson, take over Philly arena
story_log.development: Knicks won Game 3 in Philly without OG Anunoby (hamstring). Brunson had 33 points and 9 assists. Landry Shamet gave 15 bench points, Philly bench had 11. Embiid went 8 points on 3-7 shooting in first half then complained about refs. Knicks fans packed arena — might be biggest road takeover in NBA history.

story_log.title: Guardians acquire Gold Glove C Patrick Bailey from Giants
story_log.development: Cleveland traded No. 29 draft pick and LHP Matt Wilkinson for two-time Gold Glove catcher Patrick Bailey. Bailey has struggled offensively but is elite defensively. Giants get $3.27M in slot value.

story_log.title: Jets lock in Breece Hall with 3-year, $45.75M extension
story_log.development: Hall, who was franchise tagged in March, signed 3-year extension worth $45.75M. One of the league's top backs locked in through 2028.

story_log.title: Cubs hit SECOND 10-game win streak of 2026 season
story_log.development: Chicago won 10th straight game today, marking second 10-game streak this season — first MLB team to do that since 1955. Cubs have best record in baseball and 15-0 home streak at Wrigley. Michael Busch saw 37 pitches in 5 plate appearances.

story_log.title: Brewers pitcher Jacob Misiorowski throws 10 pitches at 103+ mph
story_log.development: Misiorowski threw 10 pitches of at least 103 mph and hit 105.3 — highest velocity by any starter since Statcast began in 2008. Also threw 6 shutout innings with 11 strikeouts vs Yankees.

story_log.title: Broncos extend GM George Paton through 2030
story_log.development: Denver signed GM George Paton to five-year extension through 2030. Built roster that reached AFC Championship last season.

story_log.title: Mavs hire Mike Schmitz as GM under Masai Ujiri
story_log.development: Dallas hired former Blazers assistant GM Mike Schmitz to run basketball operations under president Masai Ujiri.

story_log.title: NFL refs ratify 7-year CBA, avoid work stoppage
story_log.development: NFLRA ratified new seven-year CBA with NFL through 2032 season. Vote was 116-4. Eliminates possibility of replacement refs.

story_log.title: Christian McCaffrey and Olivia Culpo expecting second child
story_log.development: 49ers RB and former Miss Universe announced they're expecting second child.

story_log.title: WNBA season tips off with Caitlin Clark's Fever debut
story_log.development: WNBA season opens today with Fever vs Wings. Caitlin Clark in Year 3, Azzi Fudd makes WNBA debut. Toronto Tempo plays first game in franchise history as Canada's first WNBA team. Breanna Stewart had 31-10-3 in Liberty opener.

story_log.title: Bears opponents drew fewest penalty yards in NFL in 2025 season
story_log.development: Sharp Football Analytics published final 2025 season penalty data showing Bears opponents drew just 678 penalty yards — 400+ fewer than Cowboys and Giants

story_log.title: Thunder go up 2-0 on Lakers with dominant home win
story_log.development: OKC won Game 2 behind SGA and Chet Holmgren, remain perfect at 6-0 in playoffs; Lakers and JJ Redick complain about officiating after game

story_log.title: Pistons take 2-0 series lead as Cade dominates at home
story_log.development: Detroit won Game 2 behind Cade Cunningham's 25-10 and clutch fourth quarter; James Harden continues playoff struggles with more turnovers than baskets

story_log.title: Vikings sign 49ers WR Jauan Jennings to $13M one-year deal
story_log.development: Jennings replaces Jalen Nailor who left for Raiders; will play with Kyler Murray who was his college QB at Tennessee

story_log.title: Cubs win 9th straight to tie Yankees and Braves for best record in MLB
story_log.development: Chicago swept Reds to improve to 26-12, tied with NYY/ATL for best record; PCA celebrates with mop

story_log.title: NCAA votes to expand men's and women's tournaments to 76 teams
story_log.development: Committee unanimously approved expansion starting 2027; first games Tuesday/Wednesday with new bracket format

story_log.title: Taylor Heinicke retires after 11-year NFL career
story_log.development: Journeyman QB who started playoff game for Washington announces retirement

story_log.title: Knicks' OG Anunoby suffers hamstring strain in Game 2 win
story_log.development: Anunoby diagnosed with right hamstring strain, questionable for Game 3; is Knicks second-leading scorer at 21.4 PPG

story_log.title: Hurricanes one win from second consecutive sweep
story_log.development: Carolina takes 3-0 lead over Flyers after Game 3 win; could secure back-to-back sweeps

story_log.title: Rays go 13-1 in last 14 games with dominant pitching
story_log.development: Tampa Bay has allowed just 21 runs in last 14 games, only team under 40 in that span

story_log.title: Mavs Hire Masai Ujiri as Team President After Six-Month Search
story_log.development: Dallas officially hired Ujiri as Team President and Alternate Governor after firing Nico Harrison in November. Ujiri built Raptors' 2019 championship team.

story_log.title: Magic Fire Jamahl Mosley After Blowing 3-1 Lead to Pistons
story_log.development: Orlando dismissed Mosley after 5 seasons following third straight first-round exit. Sources say Paolo frustrated with late-game playcalling.

story_log.title: Anthony Edwards Pushing to Play Game 1 Despite Injury
story_log.development: Edwards listed as questionable, participated significantly in shootaround, pushing medical staff to let him play vs Spurs.

story_log.title: Cowboys Face #4 Toughest Schedule After Playing #3 Easiest in 2025
story_log.development: Sharp Football Analytics released 2026 schedule rankings. Cowboys have second-biggest difficulty jump league-wide.

story_log.title: What's Next for Anthony Richardson After Colts Decline Fifth-Year Option
story_log.development: Analysis pieces examining Richardson's future after Colts declined option. He hits free agency after 2026 season.

story_log.title: Baseball World Mourns Yankees Radio Icon John Sterling
story_log.development: Tributes continue pouring in day after Sterling's death. Reactions from players, media, fans remembering iconic calls.

story_log.title: Braves Off to Best Start Since 1892 Boston Beaneaters
story_log.development: Atlanta's hot start matches franchise's best since 1892 when they were the Boston Beaneaters.

story_log.title: Giants Call Up Top Prospect Bryce Eldridge After 0-6 Road Trip
story_log.development: San Francisco calling up Eldridge after producing just 2 runs in 3-game Rays series during brutal 0-6 road trip.

story_log.title: Savannah Bananas Pack Kyle Field With 102,000 Fans
story_log.development: Bananas filled Texas A&M football stadium to capacity for game vs Texas Tailgaters. Largest crowd in exhibition baseball history.

story_log.title: NFL 2026 Schedule Strength Rankings Released
story_log.development: Sharp Football Analytics published full 2026 schedule difficulty rankings. Lions easiest, Cardinals hardest.

story_log.title: Cavs Ice Drake and Toronto, Advance on Jarrett Allen's 22-19
story_log.development: Cavs won Game 7 at home. Jarrett Allen dominates with 22 points, 19 rebounds in closeout win.

story_log.title: Pistons Complete 3-1 Comeback, First Series Win in 18 Years
story_log.development: Pistons won Game 7, completed 3-1 comeback. First playoff series win since 2008. Tobias Harris 30 pts, Cade 32 pts.

story_log.title: Jaylen Brown Calls Out Embiid for Flopping, Refs for 'Agenda'
story_log.development: Jaylen Brown went on Twitch stream day after Game 7 loss, accused Embiid of flopping and refs of having agenda.

story_log.title: Yankees Radio Icon John Sterling Dies at 87
story_log.development: John Sterling, Yankees radio voice for 36 seasons, died today.

story_log.title: Colts Decline Anthony Richardson's Fifth-Year Option
story_log.development: Colts declined Richardson's 2027 option. He will hit free agency after 2026 season.

story_log.title: Wild-Avalanche Game 1 Ends 9-6 in 15-Goal Shootout
story_log.development: Game 1 of second round series had 15 combined goals, 10th such playoff game in NHL history.

story_log.title: Paolo Banchero Questions Magic's Championship Ceiling After Collapse
story_log.development: After Magic blew 3-1 lead, Paolo said 'I can't say we're good enough to be in the Finals or Eastern finals.'

story_log.title: Yankees Option Anthony Volpe to Triple-A
story_log.development: Volpe optioned to minors after rehab window closed.

story_log.title: Calais Campbell Returns to Ravens on One-Year Deal
story_log.development: Veteran DE Campbell reuniting with Ravens after playing there 2020-2022.

story_log.title: Fernando Mendoza Working Under Center in Raiders Rookie Camp
story_log.development: Mendoza says he's learned a lot but has long way to go taking snaps under center.
